RAVEN_ADVISOR_ENABLED.description: Enable the AI advisor UI and inference endpoints. Production defaults off; review apps override this to true.

RAVEN_ADVISOR_DOWNLOAD_ON_BUILD.description: Download the pinned GGUF model into the slug at build time. No model downloads occur in clients or on inference requests.

ACTIVE_TERM.description: Default planner/API term and scrape priority: WINTER, SUMMER, or FALL. All offered terms are refreshed.

ACTIVE_YEAR.description: Default planner/API year. Users can select all imported catalog years.

RAVEN_API_URL.description: Public API endpoint receiving scraped courses, including /api.

RAVEN_SCRAPE_INTERVAL_SECONDS.description: Wait between worker runs after each scrape finishes.

RAVEN_BROWSER_WAIT_MS.description: Browser element wait timeout in milliseconds (1-300000).
